description: This Java source file defines the FinAccountPaymentServices class, which provides a set of static methods to handle financial account payment operations in the OFBiz framework. The methods include pre-authorization, release authorization, capture, refund, withdrawal, deposit, auto-replenishment, and transaction creation related to financial accounts used as payment methods.

classes.name: FinAccountPaymentServices
classes.description: Provides static methods for managing financial account payments and transactions in the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: finAccountPreAuth
methods.description: Performs pre-authorization for a financial account, validating PIN, checking account status, balance, and expiration, and creating an authorization record if valid.

methods.name: finAccountReleaseAuth
methods.description: Releases (expires) a financial account authorization transaction.

methods.name: finAccountCapture
methods.description: Captures a pre-authorized amount from a financial account, executing a withdrawal if authorization is valid.

methods.name: finAccountRefund
methods.description: Refunds an amount to a financial account, typically by depositing funds.

methods.name: finAccountWithdraw
methods.description: Withdraws an amount from a financial account, updating balances and creating related transactions.

methods.name: finAccountDeposit
methods.description: Deposits an amount into a financial account, updating balances and creating transactions.

methods.name: finAccountReplenish
methods.description: Automatically replenishes a financial account if the balance falls below a threshold, using configured payment methods.

methods.name: createFinAcctPaymentTransaction
methods.description: Creates a payment and a financial account transaction for deposit, withdrawal, or adjustment operations, handling parties and payment methods.
